network.redirect_hosts: Add any additional artifact host reported by the approved download; keep the managed proxy and TLS verification.

secrets.value: Inject the existing credential through cloud environment Secrets; never put it in this file.

home_credit.option: Supply application_train.csv and bureau.csv, or a previously downloaded competition ZIP, through the local importer.
home_credit.download_access: If acquiring from Kaggle, the account must already have competition access. Importing existing files needs no Kaggle token.

configuration_application: Apply using the cloud environment configuration UI/workflow. This file is a request, not an effective policy.
